name: Vecima Networks Inc.
summary: Vecima Networks Inc. engages in the development of integrated hardware and software solutions for broadband access and content delivery in the United States, Canada, Japan, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Video and Broadband Solutions, and Content Delivery and Storage. The Video and Broadband Solutions segment provides platforms that process data from the cable network and deliver high-speed Internet connectivity to homes over cable and fiber, as well as adapt video services to formats suitable to be consumed on televisions in commercial properties.
